g1|variants|subscription billing.family_title: Subscription Billing Integration with SAP S/4HANA OTC
g1|variants|subscription billing.summary: This scenario family covers the integration between subscription management solutions (such as SAP Subscription Billing or SAP Convergent Charging) and S/4HANA Order-to-Cash for recurring revenue processing. Variants differ by whether billing is performed externally with pass-through billing documents, or internally via converged billing contracts leading to SD billing.

variants.name: External Subscription Billing via Convergent Invoicing (FICA)
variants.when_used: When subscriptions are managed in SAP Subscription Billing, replicated via SAP Subscription Billing integration, and billed via Convergent Invoicing before creating FI-CA/FI-AR postings.
variants.key_config: Activation of Convergent Invoicing integration, Provider Contract maintenance in FI-CA, mapping of external billing items to Convergent Invoicing item types.

variants.name: Subscription Order with SD Billing (Convergent Billing)
variants.when_used: When subscription orders are captured natively in S/4HANA SD as provider contracts, utilizing SD billing and invoicing plans for recurring billing cycles.
variants.key_config: Configuration of Provider Contract item categories, billing plans with date rules, and integration with Convergent Charging for usage-based rating.

variants.name: Usage-Based Metered Billing via Convergent Charging (CC)
variants.when_used: When consumption data is rated in SAP Convergent Charging and transferred to S/4HANA for billing and invoicing execution.
variants.key_config: Setup of rating hierarchies, charge plan mapping, consumption item mapping (CIT) in Convergent Invoicing, and billable item (BIT) management.

compare_groups.name: Order Capture & Contract Management
compare_groups.covers: How subscription master data and orders are created, stored, and maintained in S/4HANA or external engines.

compare_groups.name: Rating & Consumption Processing
compare_groups.covers: Handling of recurring, one-time, and usage-based pricing components.

compare_groups.name: Billing & Invoicing Execution
compare_groups.covers: Generation of billing documents, invoice consolidation, and tax calculation.

compare_groups.name: Error Handling & OTC Hand-offs
compare_groups.covers: Monitoring integration failures, blocked orders, and revenue posting exceptions.

g1|core|subscription billing|external su.title: External Subscription Billing via Convergent Invoicing (FICA)
g1|core|subscription billing|external su.story: Think of this as a magic subscription box that arrives every month because you signed up online, and the system automatically charges your credit card and sends the invoice without anyone lifting a finger. Technically, this standard SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash (OTC) integration scenario ingests external subscription data from SAP Subscription Billing via SAP Cloud Integration (CI) APIs, processes sales orders using item category TAS (Third-Party / Subscription) and schedule line category CS, creates Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA) billing documents, and posts convergent invoices for downstream financial settlement.
g1|core|subscription billing|external su.why_business_needs_it: Modern subscription businesses require automated, high-volume recurring billing and usage-based monetization that traditional SD billing cannot handle natively. Integrating external subscription management with Convergent Invoicing ensures seamless order capture, accurate periodic invoicing, and robust revenue recognition without manual intervention.

modules.role: Receives subscription contract requests via API, maintains sales orders with item category TAS, and triggers downstream fulfillment and hand-off to Convergent Invoicing.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable) for billing document creation and revenue posting.

modules.role: Manages contract accounts, executes convergent invoicing, aggregates billing items, and posts open items for customer receivables.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-GL (General Ledger) for financial posting and reporting.

modules.role: Acts as the middleware routing subscription events and usage data payloads from SAP Subscription Billing into S/4HANA APIs.
modules.hands_off_to: SD Sales Order APIs and FI-CA Invoicing APIs.

prerequisites: Customer Master Data with assigned Contract Account Group (XD01 / BP)
Subscription Material Master Data with Item Category Group SNOV (MM01)
Pricing Procedures and Condition Types for recurring and usage charges (V/08)
Cloud Integration (CPI) connectivity and communication arrangements set up (SOAMANAGER)

config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item category TAS: Item type Standard, Billing relevance E, Pricing X -> enables incoming invoice matching.
config_steps.check: Run SE16N on table T147L or check VOV7 to verify TAS has billing relevance E and pricing X.
config_steps.why: This setting dictates how sales document items trigger billing and pricing hand-offs to external financial systems.
config_steps.if_missing: If billing relevance is incorrect, sales orders fail to generate billing due list entries with message V1301.
actions: Enter /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter
Select item category TAS and double-click Details, or click Copy As to create ZTAS
Set Item type to Standard and Billing relevance to E
Set Pricing to X to enable condition execution for recurring charges
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Standard third-party or subscription item category
Determines standard processing sequence in OTC
Order-rel.billing - rel.to incoming invoice from Convergent Invoicing
Pricing is carried out for this item category

config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type OR + Item Cat Group SNOV -> Default Item Category TAS.
config_steps.check: Create a sales order in VA01 using material SUB_PROD_01 and verify item category TAS populates automatically.
config_steps.why: Automatic item category determination ensures subscription materials receive the correct billing and pricing controls upon order entry.
config_steps.if_missing: If this assignment is missing, order creation throws message V1357 regarding item category determination.
actions: Enter /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Document Type OR, Item Category Group SNOV, and leave Higher Level Item Cat blank
Enter Default Item Category as TAS
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Subscription material item category group from material master
Assigned item category triggered during order entry

config_steps.step: Define Schedule Line Categories for Subscriptions
config_steps.where: VOV6 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Define Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.values: Schedule line category CS: Order type D, Movement type blank, Billing category M -> bypasses physical delivery.
config_steps.check: Inspect schedule line details in VA03 for a subscription order to confirm category CS is active.
config_steps.why: Subscription orders do not require physical warehouse picking and packing, so schedule lines must bypass delivery creation while maintaining billing relevance.
config_steps.if_missing: If order type D is not set, the system attempts to create outbound deliveries via VL01N, stalling the subscription fulfillment process.
actions: Enter /nVOV6 in the command field and press Enter
Select schedule line category CS or click New Entries to create ZCS
Set Order type to D for no delivery relevance
Leave Movement type blank since physical goods movement is bypassed
Set Billing category to M for delivery-related billing linkage
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: No relevant (bypasses delivery creation for cloud subscriptions)
Delivery-related billing category used for integration hand-off

config_steps.where: VOV2 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Assign Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Assign Schedule Line Categories": Overview
config_steps.values: Item Category TAS + MRP Type ND -> Default Schedule Line Category CS.
config_steps.check: Check schedule lines tab in VA03 after creating a subscription sales order to ensure CS is determined.
config_steps.why: This assignment links the item category and material requirements planning parameters to the correct non-delivery schedule line.
config_steps.if_missing: If unassigned, the sales order item remains incomplete with schedule line missing error message V1391.
actions: Enter /nVOV2 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Item Category TAS
Enter Material MRP Type ND
Enter Default Schedule Line Cat CS
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: No planning MRP type for subscription items
Default schedule line category assigned automatically

config_steps.where: SPRO > Financial Accounting > Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable > Basic Functions > Convergent Invoicing
config_steps.values: Integration Active: X, Source Document Type: SUB, Invoicing Process: S1 -> connects OTC billing to FI-CA.
config_steps.check: Execute transaction /FICA/BIL_DOC_CREATE to verify source document type SUB is recognized.
config_steps.why: Linking OTC billing directly to Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA) enables automated recurring charge settlements and convergent invoicing.
config_steps.if_missing: If integration parameters are inactive, external billing documents from SAP Subscription Billing fail to post to FI-CA with message FICA501.
actions: Navigate to Convergent Invoicing global settings via SPRO path
Click New Entries or select existing integration profile
Set Integration Active indicator to X
Define Source Document Type as SUB
Assign Invoicing Process as S1
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

fields.note: Enables FI-CA convergent invoicing integration with OTC
Standard invoicing process for subscription consolidation

config_steps.where: MM01 -- Logistics > Materials Management > Material Master > Material > Create (General) > Immediately
config_steps.values: Material SUB_PROD_01: Type SERV, Item Category Group SNOV, Base Unit PC.
config_steps.check: Run MM03 for SUB_PROD_01 and verify Item Category Group is SNOV in the Sales General/Plant view.
config_steps.why: Sales orders require a properly configured material master with item category group SNOV to drive subscription item and schedule line determination.
config_steps.if_missing: If item category group SNOV is omitted, sales order entry defaults to standard material processing and fails subscription billing validation.
actions: Enter /nMM01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Material SUB_PROD_01, Industry Sector S (Services), Material Type SERV
Click Select Views, check Basic Data 1, Sales: Sales Org. Data 1, Sales: General/Plant, and Purchasing
Enter Plant 1000 and Storage Location 0001 when prompted
Enter Material Description as "Cloud Subscription Service", Base Unit of Measure PC
Enter Item Category Group SNOV and General Item Category Group LEEN
Save (Ctrl+S) to create the material master record

fields.note: Unique identifier for the subscription product
Services material type for non-physical offerings
Triggers subscription item category determination in sales orders
General item category group for logistics execution

run_steps.step: Ingest subscription order payload from SAP Subscription Billing via CPI API
run_steps.result: Creates Sales Order in S/4HANA with item category TAS and schedule line CS.

run_steps.step: Review and monitor incoming sales order and billing block status
run_steps.result: Sales order is displayed with valid pricing and subscription attributes.

run_steps.step: Generate external billing document in Convergent Invoicing (FI-CA)
run_steps.result: Creates FI-CA billing document ready for invoicing aggregation.

run_steps.step: Execute Convergent Invoicing run to produce customer invoice
run_steps.result: Generates convergent invoice document and posts open items to customer account in FI-CA/FI-GL.

errors.title: External Subscription ID Missing from Sales Order Item
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- Creating the Subscription Sales Order
errors.message_text: External subscription reference ID is mandatory for item category TAS
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot process the order because the unique subscription identification number from the external system is missing.
errors.cause: Sales order item category TAS is configured to require an external subscription reference, but the incoming API payload or manual entry omitted the subscription ID in the schedule line or reference data.
errors.config_step: Define Item Category Groups and Assign Item Categories
errors.verify: Re-save sales order in VA02; message V1 302 no longer appears and order status turns open.
errors.prevent: Ensure the SAP Cloud Integration mapping correctly populates the external subscription identifier into the sales order item structure.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Sales Order Processing for Subscription Billing

fix_steps.step: Navigate to item details additional data

errors.title: Item Category TAS Unassigned to Sales Document Type
errors.where_seen: VA01 -- Creating the Subscription Sales Order
errors.message_text: Item category TAS is not allowed for sales document type OR
errors.plain_meaning: The sales document type cannot accept the subscription item category.
errors.cause: The permitted item category determination for the subscription sales document type is missing entry for item category group + item category TAS.
errors.verify: Re-execute VA01 with item category group NORM; item category TAS populates automatically.
errors.prevent: Ensure transport requests containing sales document customizations include item category assignment table entries.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Defining Item Category Determination

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Sales and Distribution -> Sales Documents -> Sales Document Item -> Assign Item Categories
fix_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: OR, Item Cat Group: NORM, Default Item Cat: TAS

errors.title: Convergent Invoicing Contract Account Missing on Customer Master
errors.where_seen: VTFA -- Copying Control: Delivery to Billing Document
errors.message_text: Contract account for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable not maintained
errors.plain_meaning: The billing process cannot find the financial account needed to bill the subscription charges.
errors.cause: The customer master record in FI-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable) lacks an assigned Contract Account, preventing Convergent Invoicing billing document creation from the SD delivery reference.
errors.config_step: Maintain Customer Master Data FI-CA Views
errors.verify: Re-run billing creation in VF01/FICA mass run; document creates without FICA 105 error.
errors.prevent: Enforce mandatory contract account creation during customer onboarding workflows originating from SAP Subscription Billing.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable Integration

fix_steps.values: Role: FI-CA Customer, Navigate to Contract Accounts tab, create account

errors.title: Event-Based Revenue Recognition Profile Missing for Item Category TAS
errors.message_text: Revenue recognition profile not assigned to billing item category TAS
errors.plain_meaning: The system does not know how to recognize the revenue for this subscription item over time.
errors.cause: Event-Based Revenue Recognition (EBRR) settings have not linked the subscription item category TAS to an accrual method profile.
errors.config_step: Assign Revenue Recognition Profiles to Sales Document Items
errors.verify: Re-run billing and inspect app FAGL_ER_REP; revenue correctly populates accrual schedules.
errors.prevent: Include EBRR configuration views in baseline implementation templates for subscription billing item categories.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Event-Based Revenue Recognition for SD

fix_steps.where: SPRO -> Financial Accounting -> Event-Based Revenue Recognition -> Sales and Distribution -> Assign Revenue Recognition Profile
fix_steps.values: Item Category: TAS, Profile: Event-Based Accrual

errors.title: CI Inbound Interface Mapping Error for Rating Items
errors.message_text: Mandatory field 'Rateable Amount' is missing in consumable billing item
errors.plain_meaning: The external subscription usage data arrived with missing price or amount fields.
errors.cause: SAP Cloud Integration payload structure dropped the pricing amount field during transformation into the Convergent Invoicing consumption item interface table.
errors.config_step: Convergent Invoicing Source Item Class Customizing
errors.verify: Reprocess failed consumption items via transaction FICA_BIX_CI_PRC; items move to successfully rated status.
errors.prevent: Implement schema validation checks in SAP Cloud Integration to intercept payload truncations prior to CI ingestion.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Convergent Invoicing Consumption Items

fix_steps.values: Check mapping step for Subscription Billing API to CI Consumption Item format

errors.title: SD Billing Type Determination Missing for Convergent Invoicing Hand-Off
errors.message_text: Billing type for subscription billing document could not be determined
errors.plain_meaning: The system cannot generate a billing document because it does not know which document type to use for subscription items.
errors.cause: Copying control between delivery document and FICA billing document is missing or incorrectly mapped for item category TAS.
errors.config_step: Maintain Copying Control for Delivery Document to Billing Document
errors.verify: Re-run VF01 for the outbound delivery; billing document successfully generates.
errors.prevent: Verify copy control rules across all sales and delivery document types used in external subscription scenarios.
errors.ref_title: SAP Help Portal - Copy Control in Sales and Distribution

fix_steps.values: Source Delivery Type: LF, Target Billing Type: IV (or FICA-specific type), Item Category: TAS

g1|core|subscription billing|subscriptio.title: Subscription Order with SD Billing (Convergent Billing)
g1|core|subscription billing|subscriptio.story: Just like a monthly toy box subscription where you get new toys delivered every month and billed automatically, SAP sets up recurring sales orders so the system creates orders and invoices on a regular schedule. In SAP S/4HANA, the subscription order uses provider contracts and specific item categories to manage recurring billing through standard Sales and Distribution (SD) invoicing.
g1|core|subscription billing|subscriptio.why_business_needs_it: Subscription business models generate predictable, recurring revenue streams while automating periodic billing cycles for services or physical goods. It links recurring sales contracts directly to standard SD billing to ensure seamless customer invoicing and financial postings without manual intervention.

modules.role: Manages the subscription order entry, provider contract creation, item category determination, and standard SD billing generation.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) for customer invoice posting and revenue recognition.

modules.role: Receives the SD billing document and posts the open item to the customer account.

prerequisites: Sales Organization and Distribution Channel Setup (Enterprise Structure) -- EC01
Customer Master Data (Sold-to, Bill-to, Payer) -- XD01 / BP
Material Master Data for Subscription Item -- MM01

config_steps.step: Define Subscription Order Document Type CMOV
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.values: Sales Document Type CMOV configured with internal number range 01 and item increment 10.
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N for table TVAK and verify entry CMOV exists.
config_steps.why: This step sets up the core sales document header control so the system knows how to process subscription orders.
config_steps.if_missing: Without document type CMOV, the system cannot create subscription orders and throws message V1002.
actions: Enter /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter
Select standard sales document type OR and click Copy As (F6)
Overwrite Sales Doc. Type with CMOV and Description with "Subscription Order"
Set Number range internal to 01 and Number range external to 02
Set Item numbering increment to 10 and Subitem increment to 10
Ensure Signoff check is selected
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

config_steps.step: Define Item Category for Subscription CBX1
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Items > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item Category CBX1 created with billing relevance B for order-related billing.
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N for table TVAP and verify entry CBX1 exists.
config_steps.why: This step defines how individual subscription items behave regarding pricing and billing schedules.
config_steps.if_missing: If item category CBX1 is missing, subscription orders cannot determine pricing or billing relevance, triggering message V1311.
actions: Enter /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter
Select standard item category TAN and click Copy As (F6)
Overwrite Item Category with CBX1 and Description with "Subscription Item"
Set Item Type to Standard
Set Billing relevance to B (Order-related billing - based on order quantity)
Set Pricing to X (Standard pricing)
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign transport request

config_steps.step: Assign Item Categories for Document Type CMOV
config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Items > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: Sales Document Type CMOV and Item Category Group NORM assigned to Item Category CBX1.
config_steps.check: Run SE16N on table TVAPZ and verify combination CMOV / NORM / CBX1.
config_steps.why: This step ensures the system automatically picks the correct subscription item category when you enter a subscription material.
config_steps.if_missing: Without this assignment, entering a subscription material on order CMOV results in error message V1301.
actions: Enter /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Doc. Type CMOV, Item Category Group NORM, Higher Level Item Cat as blank
Set Default Item Category to CBX1
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign transport request

config_steps.step: Define Billing Document Types for SD Invoicing
config_steps.where: VOFA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Billing > Billing Documents > Define Billing Types
config_steps.values: Billing Type F2 configured with number range 01 and FI posting RVCH.
config_steps.check: Run SE16N on table TVFK and verify billing type F2 parameters.
config_steps.why: This step establishes the billing document rules required to invoice recurring subscription charges.
config_steps.if_missing: Without proper billing type setup, running VF01 for recurring invoices fails with message VF001.
actions: Enter /nVOFA in the command field and press Enter
Select standard billing type F2 and click Copy As (F6)
Verify Billing Type is F2 (or create ZF2 if custom required, using F2 as base)
Set Number range to 01
Set Cancellation billing type to S1
Set Posting to FI to RVCH
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign transport request

config_steps.step: Assign Delivery and Billing Parameters for Document Type CMOV
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.values: Delivery type LF and billing type F2 assigned to subscription order CMOV.
config_steps.check: Create a test subscription order CMOV and verify header defaults point to delivery LF and billing F2.
config_steps.why: This step links the subscription order to the correct delivery and billing workflows for order-to-cash execution.
config_steps.if_missing: If billing and delivery types are missing on CMOV, downstream delivery creation (VL01N) or billing (VF01) throws message VL001.
actions: Enter /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter
Select entry CMOV and click Details
In the Shipping section, set Dlv.type to LF
Ensure Dlv.block is blank
In the Billing section, set Billing type to F2 and Ord-rel.billing to F2
Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm transport

fields.note: Outbound delivery type for physical items

config_steps.step: Define Pricing Procedure Determination for Sales Area
config_steps.where: OVKK -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define And Assign Pricing Procedures
config_steps.values: Pricing Procedure RVAA01 assigned to Sales Area 1000/10/00 with key 1/A.
config_steps.check: Create a sales order in Sales Area 1000/10/00 and check analysis in condition tab.
config_steps.why: This step ensures the system determines the correct pricing procedure to calculate recurring subscription fees.
config_steps.if_missing: Without pricing procedure determination, subscription orders will have zero price and trigger message VK055.
actions: Enter /nOVKK in the command field and press Enter
Click New Entries
Enter Sales Org. 1000, Dist. Channel 10, Division 00
Enter Cust.Pricing Proc 1, Doc.Pricing Proc A
Enter Pricing Procedure RVAA01
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign transport request

config_steps.step: Define Revenue Account Determination for Subscription Billing
config_steps.where: VKOA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Account Assignment/Reposting > Revenue Account Determination
config_steps.values: Revenue Account Determination set for application V, Chart INT, Account Key ERL to G/L 800000.
config_steps.check: Simulate billing release in VF02 and check accounting posting via VF03 document flow.
config_steps.why: This step guarantees that when subscription invoices are posted, revenue is routed to the correct general ledger account.
config_steps.if_missing: If revenue account determination is incomplete, billing document release to accounting fails with error message FF709.
actions: Enter /nVKOA in the command field and press Enter
Select condition table 001 and click Choose
Click New Entries
Enter Application V, Chart of Accounts INT, Sales Org 1000, Account Det. Pyr. 1, Account Key ERL
Enter G/L Account 800000
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign transport request

config_steps.where: MM01 -- Logistics > Materials Management > Material Master > Material > Create (General) > MM01 - Immediately
config_steps.values: Material SUB-PROD-01 created as SERV type with base unit MON.
config_steps.check: Run MM03 for material SUB-PROD-01 and verify sales views exist.
config_steps.why: This step creates the catalog item that represents the recurring subscription product in sales orders.
config_steps.if_missing: Without material master SUB-PROD-01, users cannot add subscription items to order CMOV, triggering message MA001.
actions: Enter /nMM01 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Material SUB-PROD-01, Industry Sector M, Material Type SERV
Click Select Views and select Basic Data 1, Sales: Sales Org. Data 1, Sales: General/Plant, Accounting 1
Enter Organizational Levels: Plant 1000, Sales Org 1000, Dist. Channel 10 and press Enter
Enter Description "Toy Box Monthly Subscription" and Base Unit of Measure MON
Enter Item Category Group NORM and Account Assignment Group 01
Save (Ctrl+S)

config_steps.step: Maintain Condition Records for Subscription Pricing PR00
config_steps.where: VK11 -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Master Data > Conditions > Create
config_steps.values: Condition record PR00 created for material SUB-PROD-01 with amount 100.00 USD / MON.
config_steps.check: Run VK13 to display condition record PR00 for SUB-PROD-01 and confirm active status.
config_steps.why: This step sets the baseline recurring price of 100 USD per month for the subscription item.
config_steps.if_missing: If condition records are missing, subscription orders will calculate a net value of zero, triggering warning message V1208.
actions: Enter /nVK11 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Condition Type PR00 and press Enter
Select key combination Sales Organization / Distribution Channel / Material and click OK
Enter Sales Org 1000, Dist. Channel 10
Enter Material SUB-PROD-01, Amount 100.00, Currency USD, Per 1, Unit MON
Save (Ctrl+S)

run_steps.result: System creates a subscription sales order (document type CMOV) with item category CBX1.
System creates an outbound delivery document for shipment of initial subscription materials.
System posts goods issue, reducing inventory and recording cost of goods sold.
System generates an SD billing document (F2 invoice) for the subscription charges.
System posts accounting entries to FI-AR, debiting customer receivables and crediting revenue accounts.
